mapper.select: select e1.*, dname, grade, e2.ename as mgrname from emp e1 left join salgrade s on e1.sal between s.losal and s.hisal left join dept d on d.deptno = e1.deptno left join emp e2 on e1.mgr = e2.empno LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offSet}

select e1.*, dname, grade, e2.ename as mgrname from emp e1 left join salgrade s on e1.sal between s.losal and s.hisal left join dept d on d.deptno = e1.deptno left join emp e2 on e1.mgr = e2.empno where e1.empNo = #{empNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP E1 INNER JOIN EMP E2 ON E1.MGR = E2.EMPNO INNER JOIN SALGRADE S ON E1.SAL BETWEEN S.LOSAL AND S.HISAL INNER JOIN DEPT D ON E1.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO
